author: TeIq
content: Origin: #27 audit. --oauth flag in polaris-publish-labeler-record is wired to AuthMode::Oauth but submit_record returns UserError::OauthNotYetWired pending operator-supplied OAuth client-metadata JSON. The loader, the metadata-schema validation, and the OAuthClient instantiation path need a single home — likely a shared polaris-backend/src/auth/atproto module so both this CLI and the backend's M4 ATProto OAuth verifier (#31) share one config surface.
